Label: Datetime of first exposure to treatment
Derivation: Earliest EXSTDTC over valid doses (EXDOSE > 0, or EXDOSE = 0 for placebo). Missing time set to 00:00:00

Label: Datetime of last exposure to treatment
Derivation: Latest EXENDTC over valid doses. Missing time set to 23:59:59

Label: Date of first exposure to treatment
Date of last exposure to treatment
Safety population flag
Derivation: Y if the subject has at least one valid dose record, otherwise N

Label: Intent-to-treat population flag
Derivation: Y if ARMCD is not missing, Scrnfail or NOTASSGN, otherwise N. Disposition counts use TRT01P (as randomised); safety tables use TRT01A (as treated)

Label: End of study status
Derivation: Last disposition event: COMPLETED, DISCONTINUED, or missing for screen failures

Label: Reason for discontinuation from study
Derivation: DSDECOD of the last disposition event when EOSSTT = DISCONTINUED

Label: End of study date
Derivation: Date of the last disposition event

Label: Baseline height (cm)
Derivation: Mean of baseline-flagged records (VSBLFL = Y), else the first record

Label: Baseline weight (kg)
Derivation: Mean of baseline-flagged records (VSBLFL = Y), else the first record
